channel.title: Sahaj's blog
channel.description: Study notes, AI updates and paper summaries by Sahaj Saliya.

item.title: Computer Vision · Data augmentation
item.description: Label-preserving random transforms (flips, crops, rotation, colour jitter) with torchvision.transforms.v2, applied consistently to images and boxes.

item.title: Computer Vision · Segmentation and U-Net
item.description: Semantic segmentation as per-pixel classification, the U-Net encoder–decoder with skip connections, Dice/IoU, and a tiny U-Net trained on synthetic shapes.

item.title: Computer Vision · Object detection and YOLO
item.description: Detection as boxes plus classes, IoU, non-maximum suppression, YOLO's single-pass grid idea, and running a pretrained torchvision detector on a NASA photo.

item.title: Computer Vision · Transfer learning
item.description: Reusing an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18: frozen features plus a new linear head versus training from scratch, on the 8×8 digits upsampled.

item.title: Computer Vision · CNN architectures: VGG and ResNet
item.description: VGG's stacks of 3×3 convolutions, why very deep plain networks got worse, and ResNet's skip connections, with a residual block checked in code.

item.title: Computer Vision · CNN architectures: LeNet to AlexNet
item.description: The two early milestones, LeNet-5 for digits and AlexNet for ImageNet: their layers, parameter counts, and what changed between them.

item.title: Computer Vision · OpenCV essentials
item.description: The OpenCV operations I use most: colour conversion, resizing, Gaussian blur, Canny edges, thresholding and contours.

item.title: Computer Vision · Image basics
item.description: Images as arrays: height × width × channels, uint8 vs float, RGB vs grayscale, cropping, and the channel-order and range traps between libraries.

item.title: NLP · Text classification
item.description: Multi-class topic classification on 20 Newsgroups, comparing Naive Bayes, logistic regression and a linear SVM, with a per-class report and the most confused pairs.

item.title: NLP · Sentiment analysis
item.description: Classifying movie-review sentiment on the Rotten Tomatoes dataset: a TF-IDF plus logistic regression baseline, its most telling words, and where it fails.

item.title: NLP · Named entity recognition
item.description: NER as token-level sequence labelling with BIO tags, running spaCy's pretrained pipeline, and why entity spans make evaluation tricky.

item.title: NLP · Attention (Bahdanau)
item.description: Additive attention lets the decoder look at every encoder state instead of one summary vector; the same reversal task with attention, and its alignment weights.

item.title: NLP · Seq2seq
item.description: The encoder–decoder architecture for sequence-to-sequence tasks, teacher forcing, and a small GRU model learning to reverse digit strings.

item.title: NLP · GloVe
item.description: GloVe vectors from global co-occurrence statistics, loading pretrained 50-dimensional vectors, analogies, and the bias these vectors inherit.

item.title: NLP · word2vec
item.description: Dense word vectors learned by predicting context (skip-gram), trained with gensim on the 20 Newsgroups corpus, with nearest neighbours.

item.title: NLP · Bag of words and TF-IDF
item.description: Turning documents into vectors with CountVectorizer and TfidfVectorizer, n-grams, and finding similar documents with cosine similarity.

item.title: NLP · Tokenisation
item.description: Word, character and subword tokenisation compared, out-of-vocabulary words, and what a real BERT WordPiece tokenizer does to unusual words.

item.title: NLP · Text preprocessing
item.description: Cleaning raw text with regex and spaCy: normalisation, lowercasing, stop words, lemmatisation, and why modern models need much less of this.

item.title: Deep Learning · LSTM and GRU
item.description: Gated recurrent units: the LSTM's cell state and three gates, the simpler GRU, and an experiment measuring how far gradients reach back through 100 time steps.

item.title: Deep Learning · RNN
item.description: Recurrent networks carry a hidden state across time steps; the unrolled view, nn.RNN shapes, and why gradients vanish over long sequences.

item.title: Deep Learning · CNN intro
item.description: Convolutions as sliding filters with shared weights, padding, stride, pooling, output-size arithmetic, and a small CNN versus an MLP on digits.

item.title: Deep Learning · PyTorch training loop
item.description: The standard PyTorch loop with Dataset, DataLoader, nn.Module, a loss, an optimiser and an evaluation pass, applied to scikit-learn's handwritten digits.

item.title: Deep Learning · PyTorch tensors and autograd
item.description: PyTorch tensors (NumPy-like, with devices and dtypes), the dynamic computation graph, requires_grad, backward(), and no_grad.

item.title: Deep Learning · Dropout
item.description: Dropout randomly zeroes activations during training as a regulariser; inverted scaling, train vs eval behaviour, and its effect on an overfitting MLP.

item.title: Deep Learning · Batch normalisation
item.description: Normalising each feature over the mini-batch, the learnable scale and shift, train vs eval mode, and its effect on a deep MLP.

item.title: Deep Learning · Weight initialisation
item.description: Why initial weight scale matters, Xavier/Glorot for tanh and He/Kaiming for ReLU, and watching activations explode or collapse through 50 layers.

item.title: Deep Learning · Optimisers: SGD, momentum, Adam
item.description: Mini-batch SGD, momentum, RMSProp-style scaling and Adam compared on an ill-conditioned valley, using torch.optim.

item.title: Paper summary: SFT Memorizes, RL Generalizes: A Comparative Study of Foundation Model Post-training
item.description: On a card-arithmetic game and a real-world navigation task, models post-trained with RL generalise to unseen rule and visual variants, while SFT tends to memorise the training data.

item.title: Deep Learning · Activation functions
item.description: Sigmoid, tanh, ReLU, Leaky ReLU and GELU compared by shape and gradient, and why saturating activations make deep networks hard to train.

item.title: Paper summary: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
item.description: DeepSeek-R1 shows that large-scale reinforcement learning, without human-labelled reasoning traces, can bring out advanced reasoning such as self-reflection and verification in a pretrained LLM.

item.title: Deep Learning · Backpropagation
item.description: Backpropagation as the chain rule applied layer by layer; a two-layer network trained on XOR in pure NumPy, plus a numerical gradient check.

item.title: Paper summary: MiniMax-01: Scaling Foundation Models with Lightning Attention
item.description: MiniMax-01 combines lightning attention, a linear-attention variant, with a 32-expert MoE (456B total, 45.9B active) to train on 1M-token contexts and extrapolate to 4M at inference.

item.title: Deep Learning · Multilayer perceptron
item.description: Adding a hidden layer with a non-linear activation turns the perceptron into an MLP that can solve XOR; a forward pass written in NumPy.

item.title: Paper summary: rStar-Math: Small LLMs Can Master Math Reasoning with Self-Evolved Deep Thinking
item.description: rStar-Math gets small language models to strong maths reasoning with Monte Carlo Tree Search guided by a small process preference model, both improved through self-evolution without distillation from stronger models.

item.title: Paper summary: 2.5 Years in Class: A Multimodal Textbook for Vision-Language Pretraining
item.description: The authors turn 22,000 class hours of instructional videos into an interleaved image–text "textbook" corpus for vision-language pre-training, with denser knowledge than web-crawled interleaved data.

item.title: Deep Learning · The perceptron
item.description: Rosenblatt's perceptron from scratch: a weighted sum, a step function, and the update rule; it learns AND but can never learn XOR.

item.title: Paper summary: YuLan-Mini: An Open Data-efficient Language Model
item.description: YuLan-Mini is a 2.42B-parameter base model trained on 1.08T tokens that the authors report matches models trained on much more data, with full details of the data and training released.

item.title: Machine Learning · Hyperparameter search
item.description: Tuning with GridSearchCV and RandomizedSearchCV, nested evaluation on a held-out test set, and why random search often wins.

item.title: Paper summary: Qwen2.5 Technical Report
item.description: Qwen2.5 scales pre-training data from 7 to 18 trillion tokens and uses over a million SFT samples plus multistage RL, across a wide range of open-weight sizes.

item.title: Machine Learning · Feature engineering
item.description: Creating better inputs: ratios, date parts, binning, interactions, log transforms for skewed values, and target-free encodings.

item.title: Paper summary: Expanding Performance Boundaries of Open-Source Multimodal Models with Model, Data, and Test-Time Scaling
item.description: InternVL 2.5 keeps InternVL 2.0's architecture but improves training, testing and data, and studies scaling of vision encoders, LLMs, data and test-time settings; it's reported to rival GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet.

item.title: Machine Learning · scikit-learn pipelines
item.description: Combining preprocessing and model with Pipeline and ColumnTransformer for mixed numeric and categorical data, so one object is fitted, tuned and saved.

item.title: Paper summary: PaliGemma 2: A Family of Versatile VLMs for Transfer
item.description: PaliGemma 2 pairs the SigLIP-So400m vision encoder with Gemma 2 language models from 2B to 27B at three resolutions, and studies what drives transfer across a broad set of fine-tuning tasks.

item.title: Machine Learning · Cross-validation
item.description: k-fold, stratified and grouped cross-validation, why one train/test split is noisy, and avoiding leakage by preprocessing inside the folds.

item.title: Paper summary: ShowUI: One Vision-Language-Action Model for GUI Visual Agent
item.description: ShowUI is a vision-language-action model for GUI agents that sees screenshots like a person, trims redundant screen tokens with a UI graph, and interleaves vision, language and actions.

item.title: Paper summary: Enhancing the Reasoning Ability of Multimodal Large Language Models via Mixed Preference Optimization
item.description: Mixed Preference Optimization and the automatically built MMPR dataset improve chain-of-thought reasoning in multimodal LLMs (InternVL2-8B and 76B) beyond what supervised fine-tuning alone gives.

item.title: Machine Learning · Model evaluation metrics
item.description: Confusion matrix, accuracy and why it fails on imbalanced data, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, and regression metrics.

item.title: Paper summary: LLaVA-CoT: Let Vision Language Models Reason Step-by-Step
item.description: LLaVA-CoT trains a vision-language model to reason in explicit stages (summary, visual interpretation, logical reasoning, conclusion) and adds a stage-wise retracing search at test time.

item.title: Machine Learning · PCA
item.description: Principal component analysis: rotating data onto directions of maximum variance, explained variance ratio, and compressing the digits dataset.

item.title: Paper summary: OpenCoder: The Open Cookbook for Top-Tier Code Large Language Models
item.description: OpenCoder is a top-tier code LLM released as an "open cookbook": weights and inference code plus reproducible training data, the full data-processing pipeline and training protocols.

item.title: Machine Learning · Hierarchical clustering and DBSCAN
item.description: Two alternatives to k-means: agglomerative clustering, which builds a tree of merges, and DBSCAN, which finds dense regions of any shape and labels noise.

item.title: Paper summary: CLEAR: Character Unlearning in Textual and Visual Modalities
item.description: CLEAR is an open benchmark for removing information about specific people from multimodal models, with 200 fictitious individuals, 3,700 images and linked Q&A, used to compare 11 unlearning methods.

item.title: Machine Learning · k-means clustering
item.description: Unsupervised clustering with k-means: the assign/update loop, inertia, choosing k with the elbow and silhouette score.

item.title: Paper summary: FrugalNeRF: Fast Convergence for Extreme Few-shot Novel View Synthesis without Learned Priors
item.description: FrugalNeRF trains NeRFs from very few views quickly, using weight-sharing multi-scale voxels and pseudo depth chosen by cross-scale reprojection error, without relying on learned priors.

item.title: Paper summary: Movie Gen: A Cast of Media Foundation Models
item.description: Meta's Movie Gen is a set of foundation models for 1080p HD video with synchronised audio, plus personalisation and instruction-based editing; the largest video model is a 30B Transformer.

item.title: Machine Learning · Support vector machines
item.description: SVMs find the widest-margin boundary; support vectors, the C parameter, and the kernel trick for non-linear data.

item.title: Machine Learning · Boosting and XGBoost
item.description: Boosting builds shallow trees one after another, each fixing the previous errors; gradient boosting, learning rate, early stopping, and XGBoost.

item.title: Paper summary: Differential Transformer
item.description: Differential attention computes attention as the difference between two softmax maps, cancelling common-mode noise; Diff Transformer is reported to beat Transformers on scaling, long context, retrieval and hallucination.

item.title: Machine Learning · Random forest
item.description: Bagging many decorrelated trees: bootstrap samples, random feature subsets, out-of-bag score, and feature importances.

item.title: Paper summary: Emu3: Next-Token Prediction is All You Need
item.description: Emu3 tokenises images, text and video into one discrete space and trains a single Transformer from scratch with only next-token prediction, reported to beat SDXL at generation and LLaVA-1.6 at perception.
